Stirling surjection enumeration gives the stated rational A_q; algebraic telescoping yields the bivariate index distribution and u=1 normalizes to 1/(1-qt). Standard-library exhaustive literal embedding tests, independent greedy tests, integer coefficient arithmetic, and exact-index histograms pass in verify.py. Computations are finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Mandatory separation is a natural constrained-subsequence observation model analyzed in gap-constrained sequence research; arbitrary upper-gap constraints can be hard. The complete infinite-family classification exhibits a sharply tractable positive-lower-only boundary, plus an exact index distribution and probabilistic rate. The nontrivial structural statement is the canonical constant-fiber deletion/insertion of compulsory separators for all alphabets, and not a single handpicked finite table entry or normalization. Classical ungapped enumeration is openly identified as a premise; upper-bounded or pattern-specific gap models are not claimed.
